notes:
New add-ons, included with Torrio and usable on their own: Torrio Player, Torrio Music and Torrio Converter
Torrio Music: your library from your folders, playlists, gapless playback, a 10-band equaliser, loudness levelling, night mode, sleep timer, mini player and media keys
Torrio Player plays any video on the graphics card: smooth 4K, instant seeking with previews, subtitles (also below the picture), audio tracks, speed, mini player, resume
Torrio Converter: uses the graphics card, copies instead of converting when nothing needs changing, trims, presets for phones, TV and WhatsApp
Open the add-ons from Torrio's tray icon, their own desktop icons, or File Explorer's Open with (Options › Add-ons)
Files Torrio opens get their own icons: torrent, video and audio
Only one Torrio runs at a time, even when the browser starts it several times; the Firefox video button starts Torrio and the download when it was closed
The installer can fetch the player engine and video tools right away; removing Torrio ends with its own goodbye screen
Open folder buttons now show the right folder
